item.subject: science
item.stem:
During a class discussion, Meera says that the atmosphere is just the air around the Earth and only gives living things something to breathe. Her teacher asks her to think about what else the atmosphere does for life.

Which property of Earth's atmosphere, besides providing oxygen for respiration, helps make life on Earth possible?

options.A: It provides oxygen that humans, animals, and plants use for respiration.
options.B: It reflects all sunlight back into space so the Earth never warms up.
options.C: It traps some heat through a mild greenhouse effect, keeping temperatures warm enough for water to remain liquid.
options.D: It adds mass to the Earth so that objects stay on the ground.
